title: Being in Love
author: Sarita Naik
text:
Today from a distance I can feel You
Walking with me, without a sound.
I conquer the world
through smiles and laughter,
By the softness of the words
with the honesty of my heart.

I feel in love with the
thoughts of you.
My senses felt oh-so-new.
My eyes saw the beauties around.
My ears enjoyed the crows sound.
My tongue tingled at the flavours many.
My skin took a tone glossy.

When I feel about you
Days seemed brand new
I noticed things that
I never knew.
Perhaps being in love,
Can do everything possible.

A happier world came into view.
When I fell in love with you.
